ruleDefinitions.name: Always Install Elevated MSI Spawned Cmd And Powershell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Windows Installer service (msiexec.exe) spawning "cmd" or "powershell"

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe" OR process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll")) AND ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Installer\\\\.*") AND parent_process_path = RGX(".*msi.*")) AND parent_process_path = RGX("tmp$")))
